title: Microsoft Word PDF compatibility
heading: Ordinary document content
body: This neutral test document is exported by the installed Microsoft Word PDF exporter. It contains ordinary text, document properties and a heading. It contains no scripts, attachments or automatic actions.

title: Microsoft Word links and bookmarks
heading: User clicked web link
body: The following HTTPS link is an ordinary user clicked annotation. Heading bookmarks provide internal document navigation. Neither feature should block opening this benign PDF.
